parsed.note_claim: He signed with Ravenna in 2026 at 46 years old but has not yet debuted in official games.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Brazil great Ronaldinho said he hopes he can score his 300th career goal after announcing a comeback at the age of 46 at Italian third-tier side Ravenna.
parsed.reason: The article confirms Ronaldinho announced a comeback with Ravenna at age 46 in August 2026 and states he would not play in the immediate season opener.
